answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 33068 Country: United States of America Title: I follow Hanafi Madhhab. Am I allowed to marry an Ahle Hadith girl? Question: I follow Hanafi Madhhab. Am I allowed to marry an Ahle Hadith girl? If the girl is ready to follow Hanafi Madhhab, should I marry her? Please let me know. Answer ID: 33068 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1198/1198/M=1432) If you believe that the Ahl Hadith girl shall start following Hanafi Fiqh after marriage and you can influence her then you can marry her. However, if you fear that you would be impressed then it is better to keep aloof. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
